notes: The verse note offers a different construal of מְגוּרֵי אֶל־חֶרֶב; the alignment follows the ASV text as printed.

Partition verified. The first clause writes a finite הָיְתָה, so the *is* is that verb's and not the preposition's; the parallel line gaps the verb, so its copula joins the prepositional predicate under rules 34 and 49. אֶת at s021 is correctly read as H854 *with*. The added *thy* before *thigh* is right: יָרֵךְ carries no suffix.
